{{Short description|60th season of the National Hurling League}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox GAA League |league = 1990–91 National Hurling League |image = |caption = |dates = 14 October 1990 – 12 May 1991 |teams = 32 |team1 = Offaly |captain1 = [[Danny Owens]] |manager1 = [[Pádraig Horan]] |titles = 1st |team2 = Wexford |captain2 = Ted Morrissey |manager2 = [[Martin Quigley (hurler)|Martin Quigley]] |two = Galway |three = Wicklow |four = Mayo |previous = [[1989–90 National Hurling League|1989–90]] |next = [[1991–92 National Hurling League|1991–92]] }} The '''1990–91 National Hurling League''' was the 60th season of the [[National Hurling League]], the top league for [[Inter county|inter-county]] [[hurling]] teams, since its establishment in 1925. The season began on 14 October 1990 and concluded on 12 May 1991. [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] came into the season as defending champions of the [[1989–90 National Hurling League|1989-90 season]]. [[Clare GAA|Clare]] and [[Waterford GAA|Waterford]] entered Division 1 as the two promoted teams. On 12 May 1991, [[Offaly GAA|Offaly]] won the title after a 2-6 to 0-10 win over [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]]. It was their first league title ever.{{cite web|url=http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|title=National Hurling League Results 1925-2009|publisher=Hogan Stand|accessdate=18 April 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100805063526/http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|archive-date=2010-08-05|url-status=dead}} [[Dublin GAA|Dublin]] were the first team to be relegated after losing all of their group stage games, while [[Clare GAA|Clare]] suffered the same fate. ==Division 1== ===Table=== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: centre;" !width=20|Pos !width=150|Team !width=20|Pld !width=20|W !width=20|D !width=20|L !width=20|Pts !width=250|Notes |- style="background:silver;" |'''1'''||align=left|''' [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] '''||'''7'''||'''6'''||'''0'''||'''1'''||'''12'''||National League runners-up |- |'''2'''||align=left|''' [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] '''||'''7'''||'''5'''||'''0'''||'''2'''||'''10'''|| |- |'''3'''||align=left|''' [[Waterford GAA|Waterford]] '''||'''7'''||'''4'''||'''1'''||'''2'''||'''9'''|| |- |'''4'''||align=left|''' [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] '''||'''7'''||'''4'''||'''0'''||'''3'''||'''8'''|| |- |'''5'''||align=left|''' [[Cork GAA|Cork]] '''||'''7'''||'''3'''||'''1'''||'''3'''||'''7'''|| |- |'''6'''||align=left|''' [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] '''||'''7'''||'''3'''||'''0'''||'''4'''||'''6'''|| |- style="background:#FFC0CB;" |'''7'''||align=left|''' [[Clare GAA|Clare]] '''||'''7'''||'''1'''||'''2'''||'''4'''||'''4'''||Relegated |- style="background:#FFC0CB;" |'''8'''||align=left|''' [[Dublin GAA|Dublin]] '''||'''7'''||'''0'''||'''0'''||'''7'''||'''0'''||Relegated |} ===Group stage=== {{football box collapsible | date = 14 October 1990 | round = | time = | team1 = [[Clare GAA|Clare]] | score = 1-13 -
